title: ntfy (send files)
description: Sends what a flow made (a picture, a sound) as a push notification with the file attached, through ntfy (ntfy.sh or your own server): a message.send connector that needs a file every time. ntfy (send notifications) sends text alone.
setup_notes: Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to a topic. Anyone who knows a topic's name on ntfy.sh can read it, so pick one nobody would guess. ntfy.sh keeps attachments for a few hours and limits their size (15 MB); your own server sets its own limits. The credential has no secret: it lands disabled, so enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which sends a small test picture. Then use it as a flow's message.send step, its file fed from the step that made it. A server that requires sign-in needs an access token: change the credential to Bearer and set it under API Credentials.
